assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story / wordless mobile-game help diagram. ONE landscape illustration, exact 8:5 aspect ratio, designed for export at 800x500. Original warm hand-painted storybook watercolor/gouache, softly inked brown contours, simple large forms. Match the existing reference game icons' material, colors, upper-left lighting and gentle brushwork. Warm wood brown, moss green, cream, terracotta, blue-gray. Background is a uniform SOLID pale parchment color #f6ecd4 across the whole canvas; no paper stains, texture noise, horizon or scenery beyond the few necessary subjects. Keep clear 7% margins.
If a hand appears, use exactly ONE cute rounded cartoon human hand with warm peach skin, a short plain ivory shirt cuff, no body or face. It should be anatomically coherent, simple and friendly, not realistic, no extra fingers. Any visible hand uses this same design.
Explain actions ONLY with broad clear hand-painted direction ARROWS and a few tiny golden four-point SPARKLES. No letters, text, numbers, labels, speech bubbles, logo or watermark anywhere; do not paint a device screen, outer border, ornamental frame or background disc. No pixel art, anime, flat vector or smooth 3D. Plenty of blank parchment for visual breathing room. Foreground subjects gently textured but not dense or fussy.
SCENE: A single squat leafy green village TREE on the left-center, entire tree visible from canopy to roots, with warm-brown trunk. On its right, ONE cartoon hand points its index finger leftward and gently touches the trunk, thumb and three other fingers naturally curled. A small golden contact sparkle sits precisely at the fingertip touching the bark. Three chunky little WOOD CHIPS jump UPWARD from that contact area above/right of the trunk, following one short curved upward arrow. Show a clear tap-and-harvest action, not chopping: no axe, no injured character, no hand holding a chip. Tree, hand and chips are the only main subjects on blank parchment.

Use case: precise-object-edit / wordless help illustration redraw. Create ONE finished landscape 8:5 help illustration, to export at 800x500. Reference image 1 (help-tap) is authoritative for the cute rounded peach cartoon HAND, short ivory cuff, brown contour, warm watercolor/gouache paint and uniform pale parchment background. Reference image 2 (old help-pinch) is the old diagram; keep its overall small-map to big-map explanation and game architecture but CORRECT the hand so TWO separated fingertips are immediately unmistakable.
BACKGROUND: uniform solid pale parchment #f6ecd4 matching help-tap, no outer frame, no paper texture noise, generous clear margins.
LAYOUT: LEFT third shows a SMALL square village map patch with one cream-stone blue-gray clocktower hall, TWO red-roof timber cottages, green grass, one tree and ochre paths. CENTER gap has ONE broad warm-brown arrow pointing RIGHT. RIGHT half shows the IDENTICAL map, same landmark positions and orientation, about TWICE the size. No scene changes between small and big map, only scale.
OVER THE LARGE RIGHT MAP: exactly ONE oversized cute cartoon RIGHT HAND entering from lower-right, identical warm peach skin and ivory sleeve style to help-tap. This is the MAIN gesture diagram. Show the BACK of the hand with the INDEX FINGER fully extended diagonally UP-RIGHT, and the THUMB fully extended diagonally UP-LEFT. They form a broad OPEN V / 70–90 degree angle, with a large obvious EMPTY gap between the TWO distinct fingertips. The thumb is visibly shorter and broader with its natural thumb joint; the index is longer. The other THREE fingers are curled visibly against the palm as three small rounded knuckles, clearly not extended. Precisely one thumb plus one index finger, NOT index-and-middle 'peace' sign, NOT a single pointing finger, NOT two hands. Two visible nails help distinguish both endpoints. Make the open thumb-index gesture large enough to understand instantly on a phone. Keep all fingertips fully inside the image.
TWO SMALL GREEN OUTWARD ARROWS: one starts just beyond the THUMB TIP and points diagonally UP-LEFT, the other starts just beyond the INDEX TIP and points diagonally UP-RIGHT. They move AWAY from each other, explicitly showing the two fingertips spreading apart. Both arrows must be clearly associated with the respective fingertip and never point inward. No other gesture arrows. Do not hide either finger or arrowhead behind buildings. The hand lies over the lower part of the enlarged map while architecture remains visible above/around it.
Style: original warm hand-painted storybook watercolor/gouache with simple rounded forms, soft light from upper-left, organically inked brown outlines, match reference help-tap exactly. No typography, digits, letters, labels, logos, speech bubbles, borders, plus/minus symbols or watermark. Clock faces without readable numerals. Not pixel art, flat vector, shiny 3D, anime or photorealism.
Revision: Use case: precise-object-edit. Make a very small targeted correction to this supplied finished help diagram. Keep EVERYTHING exactly the same: overall landscape 8:5 composition, pale parchment background, ONE large rounded right hand with thumb and index clearly spread in an open V, other fingers curled, two green arrows going diagonally OUTWARD from the respective fingertips, the central brown right arrow, watercolor brushwork and all colors.
ONLY CHANGE: In BOTH village map patches (the small map at left and the large map at right), replace the circular fountain with ONE additional SMALL RED-ROOF TIMBER COTTAGE occupying the fountain's former footprint. This is the second cottage. Retain the existing large red-roof cottage and blue-gray clocktower unchanged. Each map must contain exactly ONE clocktower and TWO cottages, with identical building placement, same orientation and layout between small and large maps. The new little cottage is front-left where the fountain was, separated from the existing cottage by a dirt path; simplify it as a small warm cream-wall red-roof cottage. No fountain remains. Preserve map zoom ratio and the hand/arrow positions perfectly. Do not change the gesture, do not add fingers or hands. Do not add any text, letters, numerals, logo, speech bubbles, border or frame.
